user.title: Set up HeatConductor
user.description: Select the central entities. Rooms are added afterwards via "Add room". HeatConductor starts in observation mode and does not switch anything until you turn observation mode off.

data.name: Name
data.flow_setpoint_sensor: Flow setpoint of the boiler controller

data_description.boiler_switch: Switch that releases the boiler (e.g. Shelly on terminals 3-4). Optional during observation.
data_description.outdoor_sensors: Several sensors are combined; a sun-exposed outlier is ignored.
data_description.gas_flow: Used to detect whether the burner fires and for burner power. Without a meter reading it is integrated to consumption.
data_description.burner_sensor: Optional, e.g. from boiler diagnostics. Takes precedence over gas flow.
data_description.gas_meter: Cumulative meter reading, e.g. the total of an ESPHome pulse counter. More accurate than integrating the flow.
data_description.watchdog_url: Heartbeat endpoint of the Shelly script, e.g. http://192.168.1.50/script/1/heartbeat. The relay switches off when heartbeats stop.
data_description.presence_entities: Persons, device trackers or switches. If nobody is home, rooms use their eco temperature.
data_description.duty_cycle_sensor: e.g. the duty cycle of the HomematicIP access point. Thermostat writes pause above the limit.
data_description.flow_setpoint_sensor: Optional, e.g. from boiler diagnostics (X6). Used to learn the heating curve.
data_description.solar_power_sensor: Optional PV power as a proxy for solar gains in rooms with large glass areas.

error.outdoor_required: Select at least one outdoor sensor or a weather entity.

data.burner_flow_threshold: Gas flow that counts as burner on

data_description.start_threshold: The boiler starts when the weighted demand of all rooms stays above this value for the confirmation time.
data_description.immediate_start_deficit: A room this far below its target starts the boiler without confirmation.
data_description.heating_limit: Above this smoothed outdoor temperature the boiler stays off (except in comfort mode and for frost protection).

energy.title: Energy and gas
energy.description: Values from your gas bill and the boiler type plate. Changes apply to consumption recorded from now on.

data_description.calorific_value: Gross calorific value from the gas bill, typically 10–12 kWh/m³.
data_description.z_factor: Converts the metered volume to standard conditions, see gas bill (typically 0.93–0.98).
data_description.burner_max_power: Maximum load Q (Hi) in kW from the type plate. 0 = unknown, then no modulation is shown.
data_description.condensing_return_limit: Below this return temperature flue gas condenses (natural gas: approx. 55 °C).

room_control.title: Room control

data.adopt_trv_changes: Adopt changes made at the thermostat

data_description.default_comfort: Initial comfort temperature of new rooms (adjustable per room).
data_description.default_eco: Initial setback temperature of new rooms (adjustable per room).
data_description.vacation_temperature: Target of all rooms during a vacation.
data_description.frost_temperature: Target when a room or the system is switched off.
data_description.window_temperature: Target while a window is open.
data_description.override_duration: A manual target lasts this long or until the next schedule change.
data_description.write_interval: Protects thermostat batteries and the radio duty cycle. Changes of the target are written immediately.
data_description.compensation_max: Limits the correction between the thermostat's own and the room sensor temperature.
data_description.duty_cycle_limit: Above this value no automatic thermostat writes happen.
data_description.force_manual_mode: Prevents the thermostats' own schedules from working against HeatConductor.
data_description.adopt_trv_changes: Turning a thermostat by hand becomes a temporary room override.

room_control.description: HeatConductor only writes to thermostats when the switch "Room control" is on.

data.solar_reference: PV peak power for sun proxy

data_description.optimum_start: Starts heating early enough to reach comfort temperature when the schedule begins (uses learned heat-up rates).
data_description.residual_heat: Stops the burner when all rooms are above target so the stored heat does the rest.
data_description.use_forecast: Colder forecasts can release the heating limit and start heating earlier.
data_description.solar_reference: 0 = off. Rooms with solar gains ignore their temperature deficit above 40 % of this power.

error.outdoor_required: Select at least one outdoor sensor or a weather entity.

data_description.climates: Climate entities of the room; their target temperature is used.
data_description.valves: Sensors reporting the valve opening in %.
data_description.room_temperature: Preferred over the thermostat's own temperature.
data_description.weight: Share of this room in the total demand, e.g. by radiator size.
data_description.schedule: Schedule helper: on = comfort, off = eco. Without a schedule the room uses comfort.
data_description.compensation: Adjusts the thermostat setpoint by the difference between thermostat and room sensor.
data_description.solar_gain: Uses the PV power as a sun proxy.

data_description.schedule: Schedule helper: on = comfort, off = eco. Without a schedule the room uses comfort.
data_description.compensation: Adjusts the thermostat setpoint by the difference between thermostat and room sensor.
data_description.solar_gain: Uses the PV power as a sun proxy.

error.regulated_needs_inputs: A regulated room needs at least one thermostat or valve sensor.
error.monitor_needs_temperature: A monitored room needs a temperature sensor or thermostat.

no_data.title: No valid room data
no_data.description: HeatConductor has had no valid data from any regulated room for several minutes and keeps the boiler off. Check thermostats, batteries and the connection to the access point.

relay_unavailable.title: Boiler relay unavailable
relay_unavailable.description: The configured boiler relay has been unavailable for several minutes. HeatConductor cannot switch the boiler.

watchdog_unreachable.title: Relay watchdog unreachable
watchdog_unreachable.description: Heartbeats to the relay watchdog have been failing for several minutes. The relay will switch the boiler off. Check the Shelly script and the URL.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: All rooms use the vacation temperature between start and end.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Overrides the vacation temperature from the options.

clear_vacation.name: Clear vacation
clear_vacation.description: Ends a scheduled or running vacation.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Forgets learned values of one room or everything.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Heats a room to the boost temperature for a while.

clear_override.name: Back to automatic
clear_override.description: Ends boost and manual override of a room.

vacation_order.message: The start of the vacation must be before its end.
